title: Machine learning predicts ICU mortality in patients with thromboembolism or cancer
summary: Using the MIMIC-III and eICU databases, ML models predicted early mortality with AUC-ROC 0.93 (VTE, MIMIC-III), 0.87 (VTE, eICU) and 0.94 (cancer, MIMIC-III); a 35-feature VTE model from 1,651 patients was validated in 2,659 eICU patients. Late-mortality AUCs were lower (VTE 0.82, cancer 0.74 to 0.88). The models outperformed traditional scoring systems on retrospective public data.
ai_technology: Interpretable machine learning models with class-imbalance handling on ICU records
organization: Sphynx Technology Solutions; European University of Cyprus

evidence.tested: External validation of the VTE model on eICU data.
evidence.unknown: Prospective performance and clinical effect are not reported; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Trained and compared mortality prediction models.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata and author affiliations from Crossref for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
